name: Telepath
summary: Remote iOS debugging for AI coding agents — device SDK.
description:
AppTelepath turns a running iOS app into structured commands an AI
coding agent can call over a hosted MCP server: screenshots, UI tree,
taps, network traffic, logs, files, UserDefaults, SQLite, performance
and crash diagnostics — on a real device, over the internet.
This pod ships the prebuilt device and simulator slices plus the
resources used by the in-app panel.
